translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Akt
book.title: Akt Riy ta paliinna ku Iisa Masi

content: Etiyeen kaawa ɗo uŋco ka agindaw ku Yuudinnar
Kar *mee satkiner ka tatko indiig Etiyeen aman : « Kaawin kuuk ŋu kaawiy ɗo bi kan̰jiŋ-aŋ ka seener walla ? »

Ŋaar gay telkiiji aman : « Gem kol aginiyji ho gem kol siŋtay, cokiyoŋ, wiktin taat Ibraayim goyiy misa ɗo darre taat ŋu koliy Mezopotami ho min ŋa bal ɗeete misa goye ɗo geeger ka Haran, Buŋ ka *darjiner bayniiji uŋci.
Kar ŋa ɗiyiiji aman : ‟ Amal rasig geen̰jiŋ ho iŋ darren̰, ho ɓaa ɗo kiɗ kaak naan̰ gaare. ”
Min ŋaar-ak, Ibraayim amiltu min ɗo darre ta Kalde ho ŋa ɗeettu goye Haran. Min tacco mattu, Buŋ kaawiiji a ŋa ɓaa goye ɗo darre taat ku goyiy diŋka.
Buŋ ɗiyiiji a ŋaaji berin darre-ata, ho tambaay sa yaa goye eɗe. Kar ɗo wiktin taar-at gay, Buŋ toɗji wero, yoo kaak ŋa diyin baay oki ginno. Ho ɗo wiktin taar-at, ŋa ginno misa yoo mico.
An ko kaaw ta Buŋ kaawiiji awalle ɗo Ibraayim aman : ‟ Tambaan̰ asa goye ɗo darre ta geemir. Ŋu asiy ginin̰ ɓerrina ho ŋu taaɓiyin̰co nam elgin miy pooɗ.
Kar gee kuuk obig geendu ɓerrina-ak gay, nu asaaco gaarinti. Min ŋaar-ak, kooginan̰-ak yaa amile min annere ho ŋuu asiin abdiyindu anne. ”

Min ŋa kaawtu pa-ak, Buŋ obtu jamaw iŋ Ibraayim kar ŋa ɗiyiiji aman : ‟ *Ɗukume ka seln̰ol yaa gine dele ta jamuwte. ” Paa ko, min Ibraayim weeyig Isaaka, ƴiriy ta porpoɗiŋkar, ŋa ɗukumiiji seln̰o. Isaaka oki ɗukumji seln̰o ɗo Yakuub. Ho Yakuub gay, ɗukumco seln̰o ɗo kooginay ku orok iŋ seer, ŋuur ko kuuk aginiyte.
« Koogin ku Yakuub gay giniiji hasuudinaw ɗo siŋco Yuusup. Ŋu gidiyig ar ɓerre ɗo geemir. Kar ŋu iyiig kat Meser. Kar Buŋ gay goy iŋ ŋaara

ho ŋa jilig min ɗo taaɓin okintiti. Ŋa berji ibine dakina. Ŋa ginig gem sellen̰ ɗo uŋji ka Parawon, sultan ka darrer. Ɗo bi ŋaar-ak ko, Parawon diyiig guberneer ka Meser okintiti, yoo geriy oki, ŋa rasjig ɗo pisin̰ji.
Goytu kee, mey astu wer okin̰ji ka Meser yoo ɗo kiɗ ka Kana, wer kaak Yakuub goyiyo. Gee taaɓiy dakina ho aginiyte sa, gaminco ku teendi arumco tak-tak.
Min Yakuub dortu kadar *geme goy Meser, ŋa n̰aamiig aginiyte ɓaaco gidiye tee ho ŋu iyiico.
Min tee-ak gase, ka seeriŋkar, ŋa n̰aamiig a ŋuu ɓaaco gidiye pey. Wiktin ta ŋu ottu, Yuusup bariytu botol taat siŋtay ibiniiga. Paa kat, Parawon oki gintu kabarre kadar ŋu gee ku Yuusup.
Min ŋaar-ak, Yuusup n̰aamtu a ŋuu kolin̰ tacco Yakuub iŋ geen̰ji okin̰co. Okin̰co, ŋu nec gee orok peesira iŋ beeƴ (75).
Kar min Yakuub doriit kaaw-at, ŋa uctu ŋa ɗeettu Meser iŋ geen̰ji okin̰co. Goytu kee, ŋa mattu iŋ kooginay okin̰co kuuk aginiyte.
Ŋu iyiig momtinco Sisem, Kar ŋu tiisiig ɗo magin taat Ibraayim gidiytu awalle iŋ poddine min ɗo koogin ku Amoor kaak min Sisem.
« Goytu elgin kee, geente ku goy Meser weetu ko wee ho ŋu gintu dakina. Sando, wiktinti kat ase taat kaaw ta Buŋ kaawiiji ɗo Ibraayim astu ɗo werti.
Sultan ka pey gay coktu, ŋa teestu goye kaati ka Meser ho ŋaar gay ibingigɗo Yuusup.
Ŋa caaciyiig geente ho ŋa taaɓiyiig aginiyte aale. Ŋa asiraag a ŋuu orin̰ kooginco kuuk ŋu weetu daaɓinco a paa kat ŋuu mate.
Wiktin taar-at ko, ŋu weeyig Muusa. Ŋaar gay samaane ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi. Koyin subba aginiyji cigilig gerco.
Min cigilin̰ji gin ko raɗa, ŋu iciiga ŋu diyiig kara. Kar rom ta Parawon asig gasa ho ta iciiga. Ta iyiig gerti, ta maaɗiig ar roŋti ka meenti.
Paa ko, ŋu ɓildiig gamin dakina kuuk gee ku Meser ibingiyo. Iŋ taar-at ko, gee ibingig iŋ kaaw taat ŋa ibingiyo ho iŋ riy taat ŋa gingiyo.
« Min Muusa elginay nectu orok pooɗ, ŋa ictu niyine a ŋa ɓaa talin̰ siŋtay, gee ku Israyeel.
Kar min ŋa ottu ɗo wer ka siŋtay, ŋa tala kar gem rakki min Meser kooca rakki minninco. Ŋa ɓaawtu male ɗo siŋji nam ŋa deeyiiga.
Ya ɗo tan̰ji-at, ŋa pakira kadar siŋtay gee ku Israyeel yaa ibine a Buŋ yaa jilin̰co iŋ siŋ kun̰ji. Kar sando, taar gay paaɗo.
Ka kawtinti, Muusa gastu min siŋtay seer taasin̰aw. Ŋa rak leyin̰co ho ŋa ɗiyiico aman : ‟ Gem kol siŋtay, ŋaar kuŋ siŋtaɗo ga ? Maa di ku taasin̰iyo ? ”
Kar gay, ŋaar kaak gedirji ɗo giji-ak akiliig Muusa ho ŋa kaawiiji aman : ‟ Waa diyin̰ciŋ tatkaw ho gay ɗukume seriini ?
Ki rakaan deendu ar duuɗi ki deeyiig gem kaak min Meser-aka walla ? ”
Min ŋa doriit kaaw-at, Muusa kolaw obiiga. Ŋa gaɗtu kaƴa min Meser ho ŋa birtu ɗo darre ta Madiyaan. Ŋa daktu goy ar awraatin̰ce ho ɗo darre-at, ŋa weetu koogin seera.
« Ŋa goytu elgin orok pooɗ ɗo darre-ata. Ƴiriy rakki, moota iŋ damba ta Sinayi, Buŋ bayniiji ɗo Muusa ar ɗubiley, ɗatik pompil kaak kobir ako.
Muusa talig kadar ak ergigɗo pompil-ak ho ŋa ajbiytu. Ŋa sin̰jitu moota a ŋaa pandiyin̰ji samaane. Min ŋa pandiyiiga, ŋa dortu gaaƴ ta *Rabbine taat ɗiya aman :
‟ Ŋa nun-aŋ ko Buŋ ka aginiyjiŋ, Buŋ ka Ibraayim, ka Isaaka, ho iŋ ka Yakuub. ” Ɗo wer-ak, Muusa teestu azire, asaan kolaw obga. Ŋa gedarro pey tale tak-tak.
Min pa-ak, Rabbin kaawiiji pey aman : ‟ Sorig n̰ugiran̰ asaan wer kaak ki diyig asin̰jiŋ-aŋ, ŋaar *cawar.
Ka seener, nu tal taaɓin ta geendu Meser. Nu dorig niizin̰co ho nu as jilin̰co. Diŋ gay ucu, nu n̰aamaaciŋ Meser. ”

Kar Etiyeen kaawtu pey aman : « Ŋa Muusa kaak gee ku Israyeel pooctu-ak ɗoo di, ŋu ɗiyiiji aman : ‟ Waa diyin̰ciŋ tatkaw ho gay ɗukume seriini ? ” Sando, ŋa meen̰ji Buŋ kat n̰aamga a ŋaa goye tatkaw ho gay jilindi. Ŋa n̰aamig wiktin taat ŋa asiiji ar *ɗubil ka Buŋdi ho ŋa bayniiji ɗo pompil-aka.

Muusa ko imilig gee kuuk Israyeel min Meser. Ŋa gintu gamin kuuk ajbay iŋ kuuk gaara gudurre ta Buŋdi, wiktin taat ŋu goyiy misa Meser, wiktin taat ŋu aaltu barre kaak dindiko ho ɗo elgin kuuk orok pooɗ ŋu goytu ɗo goosiner.
Ŋa Muusa di pey kaak ɗiyco ɗo gee ku Israyeel aman : ‟ Buŋ asaako bayne nabiin̰ce ar nunu min ɗo ɗatikko. ”

Min gee ku Israyeel n̰umtu ɗo goosiner, ŋa Muusa-ak di kaak goy ɗatikco iŋ ɗubil ka Buŋdi ho iŋ aginiyte, wiktin taat ɗubil-ak kaawiiji ka damba ta Sinayi. Paa kat, Buŋ beriiji kaawoy a ŋaate gaarinti, taar ko taat bera goye ka gaasɗo.
Kar gay, aginiyte ŋuur pooc karmiyin̰ji ho ŋu poocit kaawoy oki. Ŋuur gay diy kaƴco a illa ŋuu yeepe Meser di.

Wiktin taat Muusa bal paaye misa min ka dambar, ŋu kaawiiji ɗo *Haruun aman : ‟ Siyte margi gii icin̰ji kar gii jaawe iŋ ŋaar uŋte. Asaan gi ibanno maan kaak asji ɗo maan Muusir kaak imilinte min Meser. ”
Hiyya, ɗo wiktin taar-at, ŋu siytu maan ar ijilin̰ce. Ŋu teestu abdiyin̰ji ho ŋu giniig ar margico. Kar ŋu gintu iidine ɗo maan kaak ŋu siytu iŋ pisin̰co-aka.
Kar Buŋ gay newsiico kopo. Ŋa rasiig ŋu abdiyiy gamin kuuk ceera kuwa ka samaaner ar taat ŋu siirtu ɗo maktumne ta nabiinnar aman :

content.text: ɗo elgin kuuk ku gintu orok pooɗ ɗo goosiner,
ho gamin ku pey kat lotu walla ?
Ku icig zug ka margir kaak ŋu koliy Malook
ho ku icig pey margi kaak ar kaalo
Gamin kuuk ku siytu iŋ pisiŋko-aŋ di,
Ɗo bi ŋaar-ak ko, naako atkiŋko serek aar Babiloon. ”

content: « Wiktin taat aginiyte goyiy misa ɗo goosiner, ŋu gin *kuraarin taat ŋu siytu ɗo Buŋdi. Muusa siyig ar taat Buŋ kaawiiji. Ŋa pinig sawa-sawa ar taat ŋa gaariiji. Iŋ ger-ak ko, gee ku Israyeel yaa ibinguwe a Buŋ goy iŋ ŋuura.

Goytu kee, gee-ak rasiit kuraarin-at ɗo kooginco. Kar ŋuur gay iciit kuraarin-at, ŋu ɗeettu iŋ taara ho ŋu iyiit wiktin ta ŋu un̰jiy ɗo darre taat Buŋ beriico. Iŋ tatkuwco Zoozuwe, ŋu nosiriico ɗo gee ku darre-ata. Ŋaar Buŋ kat atkiig gee-ak uŋco. Ampaa ko, kuraarin ta Buŋdi-at goytu nam wiktin ta sultan Dawuud.
Dawuud gay goy samaane ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi ho ŋa indiig a ŋaaji bere botol taat ŋaaji pine wer kaak ŋaa goye. Ŋaar Buŋ ka aginiyji ku Yakuub.
Kar gay, ŋa roŋji Selemaan kat pinjig ger-aka.
Yampa, Buŋ ka kuwa goyaaɗo atta ɗo ger kaak gem di pintu, asaan ŋa tatik aale. Ar taat Buŋ kaawtu iŋ bi ka nabiin̰ce aman :
‟ Rabbin ɗiy aman :

content.text: Samaane, ŋaar wer kaak nu goyiyo ho nu hokumiyo.
Ho kiɗ gay, ŋaar wer kapak di nu leeyiy asindu ho nu jammiyiyo.
Wer kaak nu ɓaay jammiye gay momo ?
Ŋa nun di kilgiyig gamin-aŋ okin̰co iŋ pisindu. ”

content: Etiyeen ɗiyiico pey aman : « Kuŋ, kaƴko bombo ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi ! Ɗeŋginko amil lawa. Ku meelgit Ruwwin ta Buŋdi ! Ku ginaag gamin sawa-sawa ar taat aginiyko giniyo.
Maa nabiin̰cir kaak aginiyko daktu taaɓayɗo ? Ŋu deeyig ŋuur kuuk kaaw ɗo bi ka gem kaak sellen̰ pakgig gee okin̰co. Ŋaar ko kaak diŋ kuŋ deetu kaawko nam ku deeyiiga.
Buŋ berko gaanuunji iŋ botol ta ɗubilji. Kar kuŋ gay pooc karmiyin̰ji. »
Muut ta Etiyeen
Min Etiyeen kaawtu pa-ak, gee ku seriiner dapin̰tu ar aditco yaa ɗoose nam ŋu uma korumco.
Ŋaar gay miin iŋ Ruwwin ta Buŋdi, ŋa kociltu kuwa. Ŋa taliit *darjin ta Buŋdi ho Iisa Masi gay peya ɗo meeday.
Ŋa kaawiico ɗo gee-ak aman : « Taloŋ ja ! Nu tala samaan pile ho *Roŋ gemor gay peya ɗo meeday ta Buŋdi. »
Gee kuuk dorit kaaw-at teestu koole raɗa ho ŋu tiriig ɗeŋginco iŋ pisin̰co paa ŋu cokiyin̰ji pey. Kar okin̰co, ŋu uciiji,
ŋu obiig cap, kar ŋu imiliig kara min ɗo geegirdi a ŋuu dawin̰ iŋ dambay. Min amil kara, ŋu cimiig batikco ho ŋu leeyiig ba serpe ta ɗubil rakki siŋji Sawuul ho ŋu teestu dawin̰ji.
Wiktin taat ŋu dawiiga-ak di, Etiyeen inditu Buŋ aman : « Gem kol Rabbiney Iisa, icit ruwwiner ! »
Hiyya, ŋa dersitu ho ŋa kooltu raɗa aman : « Rabbine, saamiyco ɗo gee-aŋku. » Min ŋa kaawtu pa-ak, ŋa mattu.
